# TaxFlow AI

> TaxFlow AI is a tax-practice workflow product in development for solo Chartered Accountants. It is designed to help organize client documents and prepare information for professional review.

The current application is a working demo; product descriptions distinguish internal testing from planned capabilities. The desktop app is not yet available to download. Workflow comparisons are qualitative, not measured performance claims. The client portal is invitation-only and is not a public signup page.

## Pages

- [Less busywork. More time to advise.](https://taxflowaiwebsite.vercel.app): TaxFlow AI helps solo Chartered Accountants collect client documents, prepare information for review, and keep the professional in control.
  Summary: The TaxFlow AI homepage explains the product’s India-first direction for solo Chartered Accountants. It introduces document collection, AI-assisted preparation, human review, and current product status.
  Topics: Tax practice workflow, Document collection, Solo Chartered Accountants, Human review, India-first tax software.

- [TaxFlow AI product details](https://taxflowaiwebsite.vercel.app/product): See how TaxFlow AI is designed to organize tax documents, assist data preparation, and keep review decisions with the accountant.
  Summary: The product page describes TaxFlow AI’s intended practice workflow, current internal testing, human review guardrails, and planned capabilities. It distinguishes the working demo from features that are not yet available.
  Topics: Tax software features, Document organization, AI-assisted data capture, Accountant review, Product roadmap.

- [TaxFlow AI workflow comparison](https://taxflowaiwebsite.vercel.app/workflow-comparison): Compare a common document-heavy accounting workflow with the connected workflow TaxFlow AI is being designed to support.
  Summary: This page compares common manual document-work steps with TaxFlow AI’s intended workflow. The comparison is qualitative, not a measured time-saving or accuracy claim.
  Topics: Accounting workflow, Tax document processing, Practice operations, Human oversight.

- [TaxFlow AI desktop app](https://taxflowaiwebsite.vercel.app/get-app): Learn about the TaxFlow AI desktop workspace for independent Chartered Accountants. The app is in development and not yet available to install.
  Summary: The get-app page explains the planned desktop workspace and shows a clearly labeled concept illustration. The application is still in development; no download is available yet.
  Topics: Tax software for desktop, Solo Chartered Accountants, Practice workspace, Early access.

- [Join the TaxFlow AI waitlist](https://taxflowaiwebsite.vercel.app/waitlist): Join the TaxFlow AI early-access waitlist for solo Chartered Accountants and receive occasional product updates.
  Summary: The waitlist page lets solo Chartered Accountants request early-access updates. Joining is free, does not guarantee access, and does not require client documents or payment details.
  Topics: Tax software early access, Chartered Accountant waitlist, TaxFlow AI updates.

- [TaxFlow AI privacy notice](https://taxflowaiwebsite.vercel.app/privacy): Read how the TaxFlow AI website, waitlist, Vercel analytics, and invited-client portal collect and handle information.
  Summary: The privacy notice explains waitlist data, client-portal document handling, Vercel analytics and performance measurements, service providers, and visitor choices.
  Topics: Tax software privacy, Website analytics, Web performance data, Waitlist data, Client portal, Document handling.

- [TaxFlow AI website terms](https://taxflowaiwebsite.vercel.app/terms): Review the terms for using the TaxFlow AI website, early-access waitlist, and invited-client portal.
  Summary: The terms explain acceptable website and portal use, the limits of joining the waitlist, and that website content is informational rather than professional advice.
  Topics: Website terms, Early access, Client portal use, Professional advice.

- [TaxFlow AI website directory](https://taxflowaiwebsite.vercel.app/sitemap): Browse the TaxFlow AI website by page, with clear descriptions of the product, workflows, waitlist, client portal, and policies.
  Summary: The website directory links to every TaxFlow AI page and briefly explains what visitors can find there, including product information, early access, legal notices, and the invitation-only client portal.
  Topics: TaxFlow AI website pages, Website directory, Product information, Client portal.

## Additional destination

- [Invited-client portal](https://taxflowaiwebsite.vercel.app/portal): Invited clients can use the TaxFlow AI portal to securely share supported documents with their accounting practice.
  Summary: The client portal is a private, invitation-only destination for clients sharing supported documents with their accounting practice. It is not a public signup or marketing page.
  Topics: Invited-client portal, Private document sharing, Accounting practice.
